response.sql:
WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
with_cross_group_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(match_count) OVER () AS cross_group_avg
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_group_average_ratios,
       SUM(match_count) AS total_match_count,
       AVG(match_count - cross_group_avg) AS average_excess_match_count
FROM with_cross_group_avg
WHERE match_count > cross_group_avg;

assumptions.assumption: A match count counts every joined fees-to-orders row, including rows where either rate is missing; the ratio average ignores NULL inputs and treats a zero feerate as undefined.
